notes.title: 周边众筹启动！
notes.notes:
致亲爱的玩家朋友们：

感谢各位对《你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈》上线三个月以来的支持。在这段时间里，我们收到了大量宝贵的玩家反馈，无论是留言、评价还是私信，每一份反馈我们都认真对待，将这些作为我们优化内容和开发续作的重要参考。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349957/81809d298300f7e158973d23e7bb3f740df65b92.jpg[/img]

此前在粉丝群中开展过周边相关活动，基于大家对周边的喜爱，我们决定正式推出定制周边众筹企划。不仅有游戏内的道具还原、女主角亲签照片、各种定制物品，还可以加入「你好家族·火种成员」特别计划，参加新作的开机仪式、拍摄现场探班，并与主创、演员一起交流。

我们期待通过这次活动，不仅能为玩家提供具有陪伴意义的周边产品，更能建立线下交流渠道，更加直接的聆听各位的建议，共同打造更优质的作品。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349957/cab8a25e4a08724f0cfcf2fa5403fcb6cd35a901.jpg[/img]

《你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈》周边众筹项目将于2025年4月18日在摩点平台正式启动。

同时，DLC内容目前已在筹备阶段，诚邀各位加入QQ粉丝群，参与角色投票，选出您最期待专属剧情的角色。

notes.title: Regarding Game Stuttering and Video Playback Issues
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support and enthusiasm for「Hello Love: 18 Again」. We have noticed that some players have encountered issues such as game stuttering or audio-video desynchronization during gameplay. After an urgent investigation by our technical team, we have preliminarily identified that these issues may be related to graphics card compatibility and settings.
To address these issues, you may try the following solutions:

Switch to using the dedicated graphics card.
Disable Vertical Sync (V-Sync) in your graphics card settings.
Set the frame rate of your graphics card to 60 FPS.

For detailed setup instructions, please refer to the official documentation provided by your graphics card manufacturer (e.g., NVIDIA or AMD).

If the issue persists, please feel free to reach out to us through the following channels for further assistance:
Join our QQ group for feedback: 1001023124
Submit your issue to our support email: Indelible_studio@163.com

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and deeply appreciate your understanding and patience. Our team will continue to optimize the game experience to meet your expectations.
Thank you once again for your support!

Indelible Studio
